propositions: reduce_ticket performs unbounded file opens that grow with enrichment re-runs, causing drain gate to breach 20 ms budget (measured 404-654 ms) on ticket repos with thousands of directories
_events_of opens every matching event file instead of reading newest-first, with reduce_ticket calling it three times per ticket and pending_enrichment invoking it as a gate on every write
filename timestamp prefix (monotonic ns integer, fixed-width) matches event body timestamp field and enables lexicographic ordering of events by timestamp
reduce_ticket must open at most one file per event type per ticket by reading only the newest matching file and falling back on parse failure

claim arbitration must read only CLAIM events newer than the latest ENQUEUE by walking the sorted suffix of filenames newest-first and stopping when timestamp prefix is less than or equal to enqueue timestamp
no on-disk deletion, rename, or write occurs; concurrency invariants and cross-clone union merges remain unchanged
